clue.text: Remaining with a certain Captain Slug

parts.note: what is left over is what remains
Captain Hook is the pirate villain of Peter Pan

explanation.surface: Someone stays on beside a ship's captain who is a sluggish creature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Slug' is the boxing verb's noun: a heavy punch.
explanation.definitionFit: A slug is a hard blow, and a punch thrown from the off hand with a bent arm is one such blow.

clue.text: See 19
Stink produced by rampant lion?

definitions.meaning: to kick up a stink is to make a loud public fuss or commotion
a heraldic lion rampant rears up on its hind legs, and a lion roars

explanation.surface: A heraldic lion standing on its hind legs gives off a bad smell.
explanation.definitionFit: A stink in the sense of a public row is a loud commotion, a synonym.

clue.text: Make-up (whichever covers a cat)

indicators.note: one word is wrapped round the others, as a cover goes round what it covers

parts.note: whichever one means any one
a tom is a male cat

explanation.surface: A parenthetical note on cosmetics, wondering which product would hide a cat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make-up' looks like cosmetics but means bodily structure.
explanation.definitionFit: The physical structure of a body, its make-up, is what this science of bodily form describes.

clue.text: Hairdo, if of curls dipped in restorer

indicators.note: the shuffled letters go down inside the other word

parts.note: a cure restores health

indicators.note: the letters of 'if of' are twisted round like curled hair

explanation.surface: A hair salon sets curls by dipping them in a restoring lotion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'curls' looks like part of the hairdo picture but is the anagram signal; 'dipped in' places the jumble inside the restorer word.
explanation.definitionFit: A hairstyle is a hairdo; the French-derived word names an arranged style of hair.

clue.text: Discarding performer's act

parts.note: the performer sheds clothes one item at a time, so the act is all about discarding

explanation.definitionFit: Burlesque undressing for an audience is a stage act built on taking things off.

clue.text: Three consecutive letters carried in two articles by northern national

indicators.note: the run of letters is held inside the pair of articles

parts.note: A is the indefinite article, taken twice
F, G and H follow one another in the alphabet

explanation.surface: A runner from the north carries letters in two newspaper articles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' sets N after the rest. Any three consecutive letters would do; the crossings fix which.
explanation.definitionFit: A citizen of Afghanistan is one of that country's nationals.

clue.text: Surrealist painter, boxing king, reptile

indicators.note: one piece holds the king inside it as a boxer encloses something
a surrealist distorts reality, so the letters of 'painter' are rearranged

parts.note: R is short for rex, king

explanation.surface: A surrealist painter takes on a monarch in the ring alongside a reptile.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Surrealist' turns PAINTER into TERAPIN, and R goes inside to make the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A freshwater turtle is a reptile; this is the common name for several such species.

clue.text: See 11
What's funny about stuff

indicators.note: the word is turned round, read back to front

parts.note: WOT'S is a comic spelling of 'what's', as in a joke or cartoon caption

explanation.surface: Someone asks what is amusing about some stuff.
explanation.walkthrough: 'funny' says 'what's' is spelt the jokey way, WOTS, which 'about' turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: To stuff something away is to pack or store it, a synonym.

clue.text: Really good and mad (one's having left)? Not in the view of dismissive type

definitions.text: Not in the view of dismissive type

parts.note: 'out of sight' is slang for excellent

indicators.note: the words in brackets are taken away from the phrase

parts.note: out of one's mind means crazy
taken as written

explanation.surface: A comment that something is both brilliant and crazy, followed by a dismissive person's view.
explanation.walkthrough: Take 'one's' out of the phrase meaning mad to get its second half.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says people forget what they cannot see, a dismissive attitude to anyone absent.

clue.text: See 19
Instructive addict's outburst: "One state!"

indicators.note: the letters of 'addict' burst apart and rearrange

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written
I is the Roman numeral one
CAL is short for California

explanation.surface: An addict shouts out the name of a single state.
explanation.definitionFit: Didactic and its longer variant both describe something intended to teach.

clue.text: Staging of Dynasty, including unstarted election process

indicators.note: the dynasty name holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: the Ming dynasty ruled China

indicators.note: the first letter of the word is removed

parts.note: votes are counted after an election

explanation.surface: A production of a TV soap opera includes an election with no beginning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dynasty' was an American TV soap; here it is the Chinese one. COUNT less its C gives OUNT.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting on a play is staging it, and the act of mounting a production is the same.

clue.text: Sportingly go down the Blue Shady Club

parts.note: sky blue; the blue is the sky
a dive is a disreputable bar or club

explanation.surface: Someone sinks the Blue Shady Club in a sporting contest.
explanation.definitionFit: To descend through the air from a plane by parachute is a sport of going down.

clue.text: Fly to see remake of Tati in Love — dire!

indicators.note: a remake reworks its source, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A film critic finds a remake of a Jacques Tati film about love dreadful.
explanation.walkthrough: Jacques Tati was a French film comedian and director.
explanation.definitionFit: This rare word means to fly or flutter, from Latin for flying about.

clue.text: Room cut into ready-assembled large fighting machine

indicators.note: the short piece is inserted into the other
the letters of 'ready' are put together in a new order

explanation.surface: A room is cut into a ready-made kit of a huge machine of war.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ready-assembled' hides its anagram signal; READY becomes REDAY, cut after A.
explanation.definitionFit: The Soviet land forces were a vast military force, a war machine in the figurative sense.

clue.text: See 19
Saw the missing explanation for heightened feelings of love

definitions.text: Saw the missing explanation for heightened feelings of love

parts.words: Saw the missing explanation for heightened feelings of love
parts.note: a saw is a proverb; this one explains why love ... stronger when someone is missing

explanation.definitionFit: The proverb claims separation from a loved one strengthens affection, an explanation in saying form.

clue.text: Step into block for an out-of-this-world facility

indicators.note: one word goes inside the other

parts.note: a slab is a block of stone
a pace is a step

explanation.surface: Someone steps into a block to reach an unworldly facility.
explanation.definitionFit: An orbiting laboratory is a facility literally outside the world, in space.

clue.text: Effective as a striking puppet?

definitions.meaning: Punch the glove puppet hits Judy, so behaving like him would be like Punch

explanation.surface: A puppet that hits people is effective.
explanation.walkthrough: Punch and Judy is a traditional British seaside puppet show in which Punch beats the other characters.
explanation.definitionFit: Punchy means forceful and having impact, which is a sense of effective.

clue.text: Leader of hike lost in quiet surroundings

indicators.note: the quiet signal surrounds the other letters

parts.note: SH is a call for quiet

indicators.note: the letters of 'hike' have lost their way and are jumbled

explanation.surface: The leader of a hike gets lost among quiet surroundings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leader of hike' seems to ask for an initial letter, but 'Leader' is the definition; 'lost' scrambles hike and 'surroundings' wraps the quiet signal round it.
explanation.definitionFit: An Arab chief, tribal head or ruler is a leader.

clue.text: Shut out male duo to keep this shut up

indicators.note: the letters of 'shut' are put out of order

parts.note: M is short for male, taken twice

explanation.surface: Keep two men out to keep this secret.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' makes SHTU from SHUT. The word is more usually spelt with one M.
explanation.definitionFit: Yiddish-derived slang for silent: to keep it is to stay quiet.

clue.text: Copper outfit knocked back in mine blown up with TNT charge

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the other
the letters of 'mine' and 'TNT' are exploded and rearranged
the abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, a British police division

explanation.surface: Police reversed into a mine blown up with explosives and brought a charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blown up' scrambles mine with TNT; 'knocked back' turns the police abbreviation round; 'in' puts it inside. 'Copper' suggests the metal Cu but means police.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal accusation of a crime is a charge laid against someone.

clue.text: Model racing driver

definitions.meaning: Kate ... is a famous British fashion model
Stirling ... was a British Formula One driver

explanation.definitionFit: The surname belongs to both a supermodel and a celebrated motor racer.

clue.text: See 11
See 19
Native Americans appear to surround stock farm, cutting off river

indicators.note: the verb goes round the other piece

parts.note: to come is to appear

indicators.note: the river letter is removed from the farm

parts.note: a ranch is a farm for raising livestock

explanation.surface: Indigenous Americans turn up around a cattle ranch, blocking a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cutting off' removes the river letter from the farm; 'to surround' has the verb for appear wrap round what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: A Plains people of the southern US, the plural form names the tribe as a group.
